text: What caused incident INC_041?
tests: Finds the app release behind a checkout failure.
expected_answer: Incident INC_041 was caused by app release APPV_GR_531.
hidden_truth: Incident INC_041 in MKT_GR traces to app release APPV_GR_531 on IOS devices (release note DOC_0251, incident report DOC_0252); app release APPV_GR_531 broke checkout for the iOS cohort: abandoned and failed sessions and technical support contacts rose after the release.

text: Which other players share a device with player PLAYER_GR_000165?
tests: Finds a shared-device cluster.
expected_answer: Player PLAYER_GR_000165 shares a device with PLAYER_GR_000296, PLAYER_GR_000647, PLAYER_GR_000870, PLAYER_GR_000905, PLAYER_GR_001405, PLAYER_GR_001540 and PLAYER_GR_002136.
hidden_truth: Players PLAYER_GR_000165, PLAYER_GR_000296, PLAYER_GR_000647, PLAYER_GR_000870, PLAYER_GR_000905, PLAYER_GR_001405, PLAYER_GR_001540 and PLAYER_GR_002136 in MKT_GR share devices DEV_GR_003246, DEV_GR_003247 and DEV_GR_003248 and bought 24 tickets for GAME_GR_03 within 120 minutes from 2025-05-31T20:00:00; an unusual cluster worth investigation; the pattern alone does not establish fraud.

text: Which other accounts share a payment instrument with player PLAYER_CZ_000836?

text: Which other markets saw incidents on the same platform version as incident INC_042, and which market was unaffected?
tests: Finds a cross-market incident and its exception.
expected_answer: Incidents on the same platform version as INC_042 were seen in MKT_AT and MKT_CZ, and MKT_UK was unaffected.
hidden_truth: Platform version PLV_PAYMENTS_3 links incidents in primary market MKT_GR and in MKT_AT and MKT_CZ, while MKT_UK was unaffected; MKT_UK deferred the PLV_PAYMENTS_3 update; see DOC_0256.

text: Which payment provider is behind support case SUP_02027, and which markets are affected?
tests: Finds a degraded provider behind support cases.
expected_answer: Support case SUP_02027 traces to payment provider PP_BLUEHARBOR, which affects MKT_AT, MKT_GR and MKT_UK.
hidden_truth: Payment provider PP_BLUEHARBOR degraded on 7 days from 2025-08-19 to 2025-08-31 in MKT_UK, MKT_GR and MKT_AT; payment provider PP_BLUEHARBOR degraded intermittently across MKT_UK, MKT_GR, MKT_AT; the failures share the provider, not a market, channel or product.

text: Which games in other markets show the same mechanic affinity as game GAME_AT_03?
tests: Finds a planted cross-market mechanic affinity.
expected_answer: The games in other markets with the same mechanic affinity as GAME_AT_03 are GAME_GR_01 and GAME_UK_03.
hidden_truth: The CONCEPT_ENGAGED segment over-indexes on the CONCEPT_QUICK_PICK mechanic in GAME_AT_03 in MKT_AT, GAME_GR_01 in MKT_GR and GAME_UK_03 in MKT_UK, with MKT_CZ as the control market; the engaged segment over-indexes on the quick pick product in MKT_AT, MKT_UK, MKT_GR; each market names the mechanic and segment with its own local code, so the pattern is one concept only through the ontology.

text: Which game in another market is the best transfer target for campaign CMP_017?
tests: Finds a planted transferable campaign.
expected_answer: The best transfer target for campaign CMP_017 is game GAME_AT_05.
hidden_truth: Campaign CMP_017 ran on game GAME_GR_05 for segment SEG_GR_ENERGOI in MKT_GR, and its transfer target is game GAME_AT_05 for segment SEG_AT_AKTIV in MKT_AT; campaign CMP_017 worked for the engaged segment on the retail instant game GAME_GR_05 in MKT_GR; MKT_AT has the same structure (GAME_AT_05 and SEG_AT_AKTIV), so transferring it is a reasonable recommendation with moderate confidence, not a certainty.

text: What is the current ticket price of game GAME_AT_02, and is the rules document that states a different price still valid?

hidden_truth: The authoritative ticket price is 2.5 (warehouse:games:GAME_AT_02), while document DOC_0262 states 1.5; document valid_to marks it superseded within the generation window.
